_comment: The Hall of Houses: what one game leaves to the next (systems/metaLegacy.js). Every House whose line ends is filed in a profile kept outside the saves (localStorage). Houses ended in a tainted run (cheats used) are listed but earn nothing. Unlocks are flavour, not power: one modest boon, a lineage and a legacy start at most per new game. requires: housesEnded, bestScore, totalYears (all Houses together), generations (one House), crowns (Houses that held a crown), ironmanHouses (Houses ended in an untainted Ironman run). grants: boon (picked as the 'Inheritance'), lineage (descendant starts), claim (the ancestral claim of a crowned lineage), origin (a legacy start).

lineage._comment: A descendant of a past House: the world remembers it in its lore. rivalFeud is the grudge of one realm against the old name (house.rivals, read by RealmWars hostility and the rival schemes); claimStrength is a weak 'blood' claim (Throne.grantClaim), only for a lineage that once wore a crown and only with the ancestral-claim unlock.
loreLines: Old songs still name {house}, {rank}, who held {peak} in an age now gone.
In {realm} they say the blood of {house} never quite died out.
Graybeards remember {house}: {years} years of it, until {cause} ended the line.
rivalLines: {realm} has not forgotten {house}, nor forgiven it.

unlocks.name: A Remembered Name
unlocks.blurb: Start as a descendant of a House you played before. The world remembers it in song and grudge.

unlocks.name: The Ancestral Claim
unlocks.blurb: A descendant of a House that wore a crown starts with a weak blood claim on a throne.

unlocks.name: The Grandsire's Blade
unlocks.blurb: A named sword handed down the line: an heirloom of your new House, with a story already behind it. If you descend from a past House, it is that House's own blade when it had one.

boon.text: You carry your grandsire's sword, an heirloom of the line.

unlocks.name: The Family Silver
unlocks.blurb: The family ring as an heirloom, and a piece of silver: the last of an old fortune.

boon.text: You keep the family ring, and one piece of silver besides.

unlocks.name: The House Book
unlocks.blurb: The old House's book, kept as an heirloom.

boon.text: You carry the House book of your forebears.

unlocks.name: Blood of the Brave
unlocks.blurb: Start with the Brave trait, as your forebears did.

unlocks.name: Ironsworn
unlocks.blurb: Finished a House in an Ironman run. Start Honest, and a little known.

boon.text: Your word is iron, and a few already know it.

unlocks.name: Scion of a Fallen House
unlocks.blurb: A legacy start: the last scion of a past House, with a modest purse and a little name.

unlocks.name: Keeper of the Hall
unlocks.blurb: A legacy start: a chronicler who has read every House's annals. Learned, poor, well-spoken.

scion.name: Scion of a Fallen House
scion.blurb: The last of a House you once played. A small purse, an old name, and a realm that remembers it.
scion.welcome: You are the last scion of {house}. The name is old and little else is left: make it great again.

chronicler.name: Keeper of the Hall
chronicler.blurb: A wandering chronicler who knows the stories of every House. Two books in the pack, little coin.
chronicler.welcome: You have read the annals of the great Houses. Now go and write your own.
